svg.title: ThermoSysPro CombinedCycle TripTAC turbine bypass final circuit
svg.desc: Engineering schematic of the HP turbine bypass to cold reheat, hot-reheat LP bypass to condenser, separate LP drum admission, and ST Trip control wiring. There is no separate IP bypass and no LP drum steam dump.
svg.text: THERMOSYSPRO COMBINEDCYCLE_TRIPTAC — TURBINE BYPASS FINAL CIRCUIT
HPBP: HP main steam → cold reheat · LPBP: hot reheat → condenser · Modelica patch V10 · NTS
B. ST TRIP CONTROL WIRING AND MODEL OUTPUTS
HP main steam → cold reheat · target 151.769 kg/s · T95 0.300 s
Hot reheat → condenser · bypasses IP + LP turbine train · target 176.789 kg/s · T95 0.400 s
LOCKED TOPOLOGY: NO SEPARATE IP BYPASS · NO LP-DRUM STEAM DUMP · LP DRUM ADMISSION IS NOT LPBP
Connection register: config/turbine_bypass_connections_v1.csv · ThermoSysPro naming HP=HP, MP=IP, BP=LP · All setpoints and Cv values are VPP provisional.
